recognize_zh: 骨髓針切片中，骨小樑之間的造血組織內有一個邊界較模糊的淡粉紅色結節（箭頭），由上皮樣組織球聚集而成，中央呈顆粒狀壞死樣，符合肉芽腫，提示分枝桿菌等全身性感染。
features: Needle core bone marrow biopsy with bony trabeculae and hematopoietic marrow with fat spaces
Ill-defined nodular aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (arrow)
Center of the aggregate with granular eosinophilic debris suggestive of early necrosis
Surrounding cellular marrow with mixed hematopoietic cells and scattered lymphocytes
Multinucleated giant cells and organisms not resolved at this magnification
describe_en: Needle core bone marrow biopsy (H&E) shows cellular hematopoietic marrow between bony trabeculae. Within the marrow there is an ill-defined aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (arrow) and a central zone of granular eosinophilic material suggestive of necrosis. Langhans giant cells and organisms cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings are consistent with granulomatous inflammation of the marrow, which in a patient with fever, hepatomegaly and pulmonary infiltrates suggests disseminated mycobacterial infection; acid-fast and fungal stains and marrow culture are required.

ddx.dx: Disseminated histoplasmosis or other fungal infection
ddx.vs: Fungal granulomas look similar and require GMS/PAS stains to demonstrate yeasts, whereas mycobacteria are identified by Ziehl-Neelsen/AFB stain and culture.
Sarcoid granulomas are tight, well-formed and non-necrotizing, with negative special stains and cultures.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin lymphoma or other lymphoma with granulomas
ddx.vs: Lymphoma-associated granulomas are accompanied by Reed-Sternberg or atypical lymphoid cells (CD30/CD15 or clonal B/T cells).
Lipogranulomas are small incidental aggregates of histiocytes around fat vacuoles without necrosis and have no clinical significance.
